description: Remove Redis dependency entirely. Make kv, cache, and pub/sub fully local/in-process first-class citizens. The current stdlib_kv.c and stdlib_cache.c have a dual path: in-memory by default with optional redis backend via use_redis(). Remove the redis path from both. Remove stdlib_redis.c entirely (the redis stdlib package). Remove redis_client.h/redis_client.c. Remove the redis package registration from vek_stdlib.c. The kv and cache packages remain as purely in-memory (local-first philosophy). Add a simple in-process pub/sub mechanism to replace the redis pub/sub functionality.
steps: Update src/stdlib_kv.c: Remove #include redis_client.h. Remove static redis_conn* kv_redis. Remove all if(kv_redis) branches. Remove native_kv_use_redis function. Remove the 'use_redis' registration from stdlib_kv_init. Keep the pure in-memory ObjMap-based implementation.

Update src/stdlib_cache.c: Remove #include redis_client.h. Remove static redis_conn* cache_redis. Remove all if(cache_redis) branches. Remove native_cache_use_redis function. Remove the 'use_redis' registration from stdlib_cache_init. Keep the pure in-memory TTL cache implementation.
Update src/vek_stdlib.h: Remove the stdlib_redis_init declaration.
Update src/vek_stdlib.c: Remove the redis package creation and stdlib_redis_init call.
Update src/cmd_new.c in generate_env_example(): Remove the REDIS_URL comment/line from .env.example content.

Create src/stdlib_pubsub.c: Implement a simple local in-process pub/sub system. Functions: pubsub.publish(channel, message), pubsub.subscribe(channel, callback), pubsub.unsubscribe(channel). Use a static array/map of channels -> list of subscriber callbacks. When publish is called, iterate subscribers and call each callback with the message. This is single-process only (fits local-first philosophy).
Add src/stdlib_pubsub.h or just add stdlib_pubsub_init declaration to vek_stdlib.h.
Register the pubsub package in vek_stdlib.c: create_package('pubsub') + stdlib_pubsub_init.
Update Makefile if needed (remove redis_client.o and stdlib_redis.o, add stdlib_pubsub.o - but since Makefile uses wildcard this should be automatic).
Verify no remaining references to redis in source files.
acceptance_criteria: src/redis_client.h, src/redis_client.c, src/stdlib_redis.c are all deleted
src/stdlib_kv.c has no redis references and no use_redis function
src/stdlib_cache.c has no redis references and no use_redis function
src/stdlib_pubsub.c exists with local pub/sub implementation
vek_stdlib.c registers pubsub package instead of redis
No references to REDIS_URL, redis_connect, redis_client.h remain in src/
verification: Run 'make clean && make' and confirm zero compile errors
Run 'grep -ri redis src/' and confirm no results
Run 'grep -ri REDIS src/' and confirm no results
findings: All redis code removed cleanly. Build compiles with zero errors. All unit tests pass. Integration tests stdlib_basic and stdlib_pages have pre-existing flaky failures (whitespace comparison issue in test runner, not related to our changes). The pubsub module uses vm_push/vm_call pattern for calling subscriber callbacks, matching existing stdlib conventions.
